en: A vintage-style sepia postcard showing a town square dominated by a clock tower. Surrounding the square are classic European buildings with decorative facades and balconies. The square itself, 'Piazza Scario,' is shown with a few people scattered around. The text on the postcard identifies the location as Cavalese and names the scene as Piazza Scario e Ponte del rivo Gambis.
